observations: Photo shows a Yamaha PSR-style electronic keyboard with built-in speakers on both left and right ends.
Brand/model text appears on the control panel area: 'YAMAHA' and 'PSR-175' is readable.
LCD screen is present but its content is not clearly readable in the photo.
No visible close-ups of keys condition, power adapter/ports, or any labels/serial number.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the keyboard, but there is no proof of power-on, audio output, or functioning buttons/keys.

claims.claim: it's used please note but working perfectly well
claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not confirm usage history or verify performance; only the physical unit is shown.

risks.risk: Not actually working (no power, dead keys, faulty speakers, or broken buttons)
risks.proof: A short video clip showing power-on, LCD turning on, playing several keys, and hearing sound through the built-in speakers (or headphone output).
risks.if_unproven: Price it as not fully verified/possibly needing repair (worst case: treat as not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Some keys or functions may be faulty (intermittent key contacts, sustain/controls not responding)
risks.proof: Video showing a full octave test (left-to-right keys) plus testing at least: volume knob, rhythm/style buttons, and one demo/voice selection.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as having potential functional issues until tested.

risks.risk: Missing accessories or power adapter (or wrong adapter) affecting usability
risks.proof: Photo of the included items: power adapter/charger label and the keyboard’s power input port.
risks.if_unproven: Price it assuming accessories may be missing or not included.

risks.risk: LCD/backlight or display may be damaged even if sound works
risks.proof: Close-up photo/video of the LCD screen while powered on, showing readable text/menus.
risks.if_unproven: Price it as display condition unknown.

proof_requests: Send a video: power-on + LCD on + play several keys + confirm sound from speakers (and/or headphone jack).
Show a quick full key-range test (at least one octave up and down) and demonstrate volume control working.
Confirm what accessories are included (especially the exact power adapter) with a photo of the adapter label and the keyboard power port.
response.reason: The model (Yamaha PSR-175) is readable from the photo, but the seller’s 'working perfectly' claim is not verifiable remotely without a power-on/audio test. Request proof before pricing confidently.
